spans.s:
m. (-गः)
1 Sickness, disease in general, or a disease.
2 A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.)
E.
रुज to be or make sick, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Sick, diseased.
E.
रोग, and ग्रस्त seized.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Curative, medical.
E.
रोग, and घ्न what destroys.

f. (-भूः)
The body.
E.
रोग disease, and भू the soil.

m. (-जः)
Consumption.
E.
रोग disease, and राज principal.

n. (-णं)
The symptoms or sign of a disease, or of its progress.
E.
रोग a disease, and लक्षण mark.

m. (-कः)
A physician.
E.
रोग disease, and शान्तक alleviator.

f. (-न्तिः)
Cure or alleviation of disease.
E.
रोग, and शान्ति appeasing; also रोगशमः and the like.

m. (-ल्पी)
A tree, (Cassia fistula.)
E.
रोग disease, and शिल्पिन् an artisan.

n. (-हं)
A drug, a medicament.
E.
रोग disease, हा to abandon, aff. क.

m. (-हा)
A physician.
E.
रोग, and हन to destroy, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Curative, medicinal.
E.
रोग, and हर what takes.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Curative, medicinal.
m. (-री)
A physician.
E.
रोग disease, हृ to remove, to take away, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Curative, medicinal.
m. (-कः)
A physician.
E.
रोग, and अन्तक destroyer.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sick, diseased.
E.
रोग, and अन्वित having.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Suffering pain or sickness.
E.
रोग, and आर्त्त pained.

f. (-ता)
Sickness, disease.
E.
रोगिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रोगित्वं.

mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि)
Diseased, ill, sick, affected with sickness or disease.
E.
रोग disease, and इनि aff.

n. (-भं)
A drug, a medicament.
E.
रोगि a sick man, and वल्लभ the friend.

m. (-मः)
Cure or alleviation of disease.
E.
रोग, and उपशम allaying.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
1 Counter-indicated, as menstrua or regimen, &c., what is improper to be taken in any disease or with the medicines administered.
2 Related to or connected with disease.
E.
रोग sickness, and यत् aff.
